description: C+GDROM parameters cover 1,758 United States reservoirs, supplying seasonal storage-curve parameters and capacity features. Reservoir selection requires at least five years of records after 1990 and sufficient seasonal variation. This resource is provided by Yanan Chen; Zihan Zheng; Yuanzhe Wang and coauthors. Coverage is national as described above; spatial resolution, sampling detail and time coverage beyond those stated remain unknown. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: This resource is shared under the Creative Commons Attribution CC BY.. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: The calibrated subset excludes reservoirs failing these criteria and does not establish out-of-sample performance everywhere. For simulation, it can supply inputs or comparison evidence. Related catalogue record: model-hec-ras. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
